content: Sohte Katepen Inou ong Isip
KAUN-O mahsanih, “Meid suwediong irail kan me kaunda Suda, pwehki ar kahngohdiong ie. Re kin kapwaiada koasoandi kei me kin uhwong kupwurei. Re kin katohtohwehla diparail kan.
Re kin rapahki sawasaparail sang Isip, ni ar sohte kin ale kaweid sang rehi. Re kin men Isip en doandoare irail, ihme kahrehda re kin koapworopworki nanmwarkien Isip.
Ahpw sohte sapwellimen nanmwarkio manaman en sewese irail, ihme kahrehda arail sawas sang Isip sohte pahn pweida, pwe kauparailte me pahn wiawi.
Mehnda ma wiliaparail lellahngehr nan kahnimw Soan oh Anes nan Isip,
ahpw mehn Suda kan pahn koluhkihla ar koapworopworki wehio me keseulikilik, wehi me sohte kin sewese irail nan arail kasikasik sawas.”

Iet mahsen en Koht duwen mahn akan nan sapwtehn ni palieir: “Wiliaparail kan pahn keid wasa keper, wasa me laion kan kin mihmi ie, iangahki sineik pwoisin oh sineik pihr kan. Neirail ahs oh kamel kan weuwa mehn kisakis pweilaud ong wehi ehu me sohte kak sewese irail.
Sohte katepen sawas me Isip kak kihda, ihme kahrehda I kihong Isip adamwahl wet, ‘Mahn Likemisek Sohte Keper.’”
Aramas Sapeik kan
Koht ketin mahsanihong ie I en ntingihedi nan pwuhk ehu duwen iren mouren aramas pwukat, pwe en wia kadehde poatopoat ong pein arail suwed.
Irail kin kahngohdiong Koht ahnsou koaros, likamw ahnsou koaros, oh kahng rong sapwellimen KAUN-O padahk ahnsou koaros.

Re kin ndahng soukohp kan en nennenla, oh kin ndahng irail, “Kumwail dehr padahkihong kiht dahme pwung. Ahpw kumwail padahkihong kiht dahme se kin men rong. Kumwail piseksang kiht pwe se pahn kolokolete nsenat.
Kumwail keisang mwoht, dehr kedirepwei kiht. Se soh mwahn men rong duwen amwail Koht sarawien Israel.”
Ahpw iet mahsen en Koht sarawien Israel: “Kumwail kin pohnsehse dahme I kin padahkihong kumwail, ahpw kumwail kin koapworopworkihte amwail kamaramas oh widing.
Kumwail dipadahr! Kumwail rasehng dihd ileile ehu me pwalpeseng sang powe lel pah; eri, kumwail pahn mwadang rengkidi.
Kumwail pahn pwaltikpeseng, rasehng sah me wiawihkihda pwehl, ohla douluhl oh sohte dipere ehu me aramas kak kolkihda mwoalus, de idipkihda kisin pihl kis sang nan pwarer.”

KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, Me Sarawien Israel, ketin mahsanihong aramas pwukat, “Kumwail pwurodo oh koapworopworkin ie, pwe kumwail en kehlailla oh saledeksang amwail kahpwal akan.” Ahpw kumwail kahng kapwaiada.

A ih me kumwail wiahn: kumwail koasoanehdi kumwail en tangasang amwail imwintihti kan ni amwail pahn dake oahs marahra kan. Eri, kumwail me pwung! Kumwail uhdahn anahne pitla. Kumwail lemeleme me noumwail oahs akan me marahra, ahpw me pwakipwakih kumwail kan marahrahsang.

Ma kumwail pahn kilang imwintihti men, a me kid rehmwail pahn tang; a ma me limmen, kumwail koaros pahn tangdoaui. Sohte emen noumwail sounpei kan pahn luhwe, ihte tuhkehn pilaik pwoat me pahn luhwehdi pohn dohlo.
Ahpw KAUN-O ketin kaunopada en kupwurmahk oh kalahngan ong kumwail, pwehki eh kin ketin wia me pwung ahnsou koaros. Meid pai irail kan me kin likih KAUN-O.
Koht pahn ketin Kupwuramwahwih Sapwellime Aramas akan
Kumwail kan me kin kousoan nan Serusalem solahr pahn mwahiei. KAUN-O me kupwurkalahngan, oh ni amwail pahn peki sapwellime sawas, e pahn ketin kupwurei kumwail.
KAUN-O pahn ketikihong kumwail nan apwal, ahpw pein ih pahn ket rehmwail pwe en ketin padahkih kumwail, oh kumwail solahr pahn rapahki ih.
Ma kumwail pahn salongasang nan ahlo oh kolahng ni palimeing de maun, kumwail pahn rong kapitie sang mwurimwail me mahsanih, “Iet ahlo. kumwail idawehn.”
Kumwail pahn ale noumwail dikedik en eni kan me wiawihkihda silper oh kohl, oh kesehla rasehng mehkot saut, oh weriwer, ndinda, “Kumwail pwulahkasang met!”
Ahnsou koaros me kumwail pahn padokedi wahnsahpw, Kaun-o pahn ketikihdo keteu pwehn kakairada oh pahn ketikihong kumwail wahnsahpw ngeder, oh wasahn kamwenge mahn pahn laud ong noumwail pelinmen kan.
Kou oh ahs akan me kin deipwelih amwail mwaht akan pahn kin kang reh me keieu mwahu oh kaselel.
Ni rahn me en amwail imwintihti kan kelen mahwen pahn lohdi oh towe kan kamakamala, pihl pahn pwilidohsang pohn nahna koaros oh dohl koaros.

Maram pahn marainla duwehte ketipin, oh ketipin pahn marainla pahn pak isipak, rasehng marain en rahn isuh me patpene nan rahn ehu. Mepwukat pahn pweida ni ahnsou me KAUN-O pahn ketin kidimala ohla kan oh kamwahwihala ohla kan me e ketikihongehr sapwellime aramas akan.
Koht pahn ketin Kaloke Asiria
Sapwellimen KAUN-O manaman oh lingan kak sansaldo sang wasa doh. Kisiniei oh ediniei kin sansalda nan sapwellime engieng. E kin ketin mahsen, oh sapwellime mahsen kan kin lulda rasehng kisiniei.
E kin ketin kadarodo kisinieng mwowe rasehng lapake me kin kapeila mehkoaros. E kin ketin kapeila wehi koaros oh katokihedi arail koasoandi suwed kan.

Ahpw kumwail, sapwellimen Koht aramas akan, pahn pereperen oh kokoul duwehte me kumwail kin wia ni rahn sarawi lapalap ehu. Kumwail pahn pereperen duwehte irail kan me kin kesekesengki keseng pepeuk kohdalahng ni Tehnpas Sarawien KAUN-O, soundoarepen Israel.
KAUN-O pahn ketin kupwurehda pwe aramas koaros en rong kapitie oh kehn engin sapwellime engieng. Mpwulen kisiniei pahn mie, keteu aihs takai, pil depwek toatoal en melimel, oh keteu mosul.
Mehn Asiria pahn masepwehkada ni ar pahn rong kapitien KAUN-O oh kehn engin sapwellime kalokolok.
Nindokon KAUN-O eh pahn ketin kalokaloke irail sohte tokedi, sapwellime aramas akan pahn kesekesengki nair aip kan oh arp kan. Pein Koht me pahn ketin mahweniong mehn Asiria kan.

Mahsie wasa kis kaunopadahr pwe lapalahn kisiniei ehu en lulda oh kamwasikahla nanmwarki lapalap en Asiria. Wasao inenen loal oh tehlap, oh tuwi tohto koasoakoasoakdahr ie. Engin doauesen KAUN-O me pahn peuk pwe en kalulada.
